verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Editor documents built-in real-time collaboration, where multiple people build the same scene at once with no merge conflicts, plus project checkpoints for snapshot and rollback. That clearly covers the multi-person team side of the story. Coverage of the version-control side is thin: community users ask for the ability to use their own source control, and the only Git-friendly paths are local script editing via the VS Code extension and the community-cited playcanvas-sync tool. missing for 10: documented diffable or mergeable text scene formats, first-class integration with external version control such as Git, independent hands-on corroboration of collaboration at studio scale.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration

citations.quote: Multiple developers, artists, and designers can build the same scene simultaneously—no merge conflicts, no stepping on each other's toes.
Checkpoints — Snapshot your project at any point and roll back if needed
Edit its scripts locally with the VS Code extension
